subject: Azure Marketplace integration: post-call recap and technical deep-dive slotting
messages:
From: David Liu <dliu@microsoft.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam@orbitgsi.com>
Date: 2027-11-06T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Azure Marketplace integration: discovery recap + proposed next steps

Hi Irene / Camila —

Thanks for a productive call this morning. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we all have alignment: 

Summary from today's discovery:
- Goal: list Redwood's Hosted API offering in Azure Marketplace with metered billing and co-sell eligibility.
- Integration surface: offer packaging, metering (usage reporting), SSO (SAML/OAuth), and optional private offer flow.
- Security/compliance: Azure requires audit log visibility and a minimal data flow diagram for Marketplace listing.

Proposed next steps:
1) Technical deep dive (30-60m) to confirm integration points (metering endpoint, auth flows, telemetry).
2) Provide architecture diagram + sample offer template.
3) Identify sandbox account and contact for validation.

Suggested slots (PST):
- Wed Nov 10, 10:00–11:00 (PST)
- Thu Nov 11, 14:00–15:00 (PST)

Please confirm which slot works and who from your side should attend (we recommend product + infra + partner ops). I attached a short checklist that covers typical marketplace integration blockers.

Attachment: MVP-integration-checklist.pdf (PDF, 45KB)

Best,
David Liu
Partner PM, Azure Marketplace
Microsoft
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: David Liu <dliu@microsoft.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-06T11:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Azure Marketplace integration: discovery recap + proposed next steps

Thanks David — great summary and very helpful checklist.

We can do the technical deep dive. Proposed attendees from Redwood:
- Irene Choi (Product / Partner lead)
- Ben Carter (Solutions Architect)
- Camila Reyes (Partner PM)
- Marcus Lin (Infra lead) — I'll add him to the thread for visibility.

Thu Nov 11, 14:00–15:00 (PST) works best for our team (the Wed slot conflicts with a town hall). Can you confirm the timezone for the invite (PST)? Also: a couple asks ahead of the deep dive so we can come prepared:
- Can you share a sandbox/subscription we can test metering against (or the steps to request one)?
- Any specific auth example you prefer (SAML vs OAuth) for the private offer flow?
- If you have a sample offer manifest or sample private-offer workflow, please drop it in the Drive link.

I've attached a short list of readiness questions and a minimal architecture stub that will help us prepare. If Thu is confirmed we'll block calendars and chase calendar invites.

Attachment: integration-readiness-questions.docx (DOCX, 12KB)

Thanks — Irene
Irene Choi
Partner Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: David Liu <dliu@microsoft.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-06T12:15:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Azure Marketplace integration: discovery recap + proposed next steps

Irene — I can make Thu 11/11 14:00 PST. Adding Marcus (infra) since we'll likely need his input on metering endpoints and any certificate exchange.

If David can share the expected metering API shape (payload + auth), I'll validate whether we need a brief internal spike before the call. Otherwise I'll come prepared to discuss our current metering/export endpoints.

— Ben
Ben Carter
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
From: David Liu <dliu@microsoft.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-06T15:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Azure Marketplace integration: discovery recap + proposed next steps

Perfect — Thu Nov 11, 14:00–15:00 PST is confirmed. I'll send the calendar invite shortly (calendar link below) and include the Azure marketplace engineering lead.

Pre-reads I'm sharing now:
- Sample offer manifest (Drive link): https://drive.microsoft.com/sample-offer-manifest
- Metering API spec: https://docs.microsoft.com/marketplace/metering-api (public)

Calendar invite: https://calendar.microsoft.com/invite/abc123

Best,
